integrity: An all-parameter simplicial attachment proof and a dependency-free finite exact verifier are included. No independent mathematical audit or external validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Applies to the inclusive graph-metric cyclic Rips complexes on 3k vertices at radius k, for all integers k>=2. Establishes integral homology as a dihedral module, not an equivariant homotopy equivalence or quotient-space homology. The already known nonequivariant sphere-wedge classification is not claimed as new; equivalent unindexed equivariant work remains possible.
title: The signed augmentation lattice at the first cyclic Rips transition
